pages.title: Euler's Identity
pages.text: e^(iπ) + 1 = 0: the five most important numbers, from five fields of mathematics, in one line. Proved on the Formal Proof Assistant. As a catalyst it never wears: the Concept Compressor makes a Mathematics Singularity from half of everything with it, and the Proof Assistant a Riemann Zeta Crystal from primes and π.
